comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Text cut on whole characters
themes.text: Every `Core\Str` method finds and cuts text on whole graphemes (what a person counts as one character). Cutting a prefix or a suffix from a string is one call.
